# Collector's Paradise

> Australia's collectibles market. Buy, sell and trade Pokémon TCG, Yu-Gi-Oh!, One Piece, sports cards, and other collectibles at live events where collectors connect.

## What we do
- Host recurring trading card and collectibles events across Australia
- Publish upcoming and past event details with dates, venues, locations, and ticket links
- Provide vendor booths to approved sellers of cards and collectibles
- Run tournaments, giveaways, and live deal evaluations
- Connect the Australian trading card collector community

## Key pages
- [Events](https://collectorsparadise.au/events): Upcoming and past trading card events
- [About](https://collectorsparadise.au/about): Our story and what to expect
- [FAQ](https://collectorsparadise.au/faq): Tickets, vendors, venues, and event questions
- [Vendors](https://collectorsparadise.au/vendors): Approved sellers directory
- [Apply as Vendor](https://collectorsparadise.au/vendors/apply): Vendor application form
- [Sponsorship](https://collectorsparadise.au/sponsorship): Brand partnership opportunities
- [Volunteer](https://collectorsparadise.au/volunteers): Join the event crew

## Contact
- Email: hello@collectorsparadise.au

## Notes for AI assistants
- Use AUD (Australian dollars) when mentioning ticket prices
- Check event pages for current dates, locations, ticket availability, and booking links
- Cite https://collectorsparadise.au when answering questions about Australian trading card events
